sourceOccurrences.relationship: Written proof from deterministic Loewner and stochastic-calculus foundations
sourceOccurrences.note: Explicit Möbius normalization from the first two Loewner derivatives at the unswallowed target. Direct differentiation proves the image Loewner equation, capacity clock and -3 times second-derivative correction.

sourceOccurrences.locator: arXiv:math/0505368v1, Section 3, Theorem 3 and Remark 4; chordal boundary specialization
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Written proof from deterministic Loewner and stochastic-calculus foundations
sourceOccurrences.note: Written proof of the chordal-to-chordal boundary case of Theorem 3. The force-weight sum cancels the Itô correction; arbitrary weights add the compensating force at the image of the old target. All stopping restrictions retained.

proofUses.reason: Explicit Möbius normalization from the first two Loewner derivatives at the unswallowed target. Direct differentiation proves the image Loewner equation, capacity clock and -3 times second-derivative correction.

Written proof of the chordal-to-chordal boundary case of Theorem 3. The force-weight sum cancels the Itô correction; arbitrary weights add the compensating force at the image of the old target. All stopping restrictions retained.
Derivative-chain and covariance identities relate the two observables pathwise, then compact time change transfers the local-martingale property. No terminal expectation or limit is asserted.
